blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla said authorities have identified members of True Brown Style (TBS) in Cebu, warning the group that he would have them jailed. The disclosure comes as the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) steps up efforts to address groups allegedly recruiting minors into criminal activity, including initiation rites that reportedly involve theft. Remulla said TBS operated across Cebu province, particularly in highly urbanized cities (HUCs), but did not name specific locations or disclose how many members authorities had identified.
